i.norm: Verifies that {@link LineIterator#nextLine()} returns every line of a UTF-8 encoded file in order and then reports no further lines.
Builds the list of expected lines, e.g. {@code ["LINE 0", "LINE 1", ...]}. @param lineCount number of lines to create. @return the expected lines.

Reads the given file line-by-line through {@link LineIterator#nextLine()} and asserts that the lines match {@code expectedLines}, with nothing left over once they are all consumed. Closes the iterator afterwards. @param expectedLines the lines the iterator is expected to yield. @param iterator the iterator under test.
